page.intro: TSSX is committed to building a sustainable future by taking responsibility in environmental, social, and economic domains. Our strategies aim to benefit both our company and society.

introduction.title: Introduction and Overview
introduction.description: This document outlines TSSX Information Technologies and Consulting Inc.'s sustainability efforts and commitments. The company adopts a range of strategies and policies to fulfill its environmental, social, and economic responsibilities.

environmental.title: Environmental Responsibility
items: Implement waste reduction and reuse strategies

social.title: Social Responsibility
items: Fair wage policies and employee welfare enhancement
Provide education and development opportunities for employees
Active participation in local community projects

waste.title: Waste Management and Recycling
items: Expand recycling programs in all work environments

employee.title: Employee Rights and Welfare
items: Programs supporting employee health and welfare

community.title: Community Engagement and Volunteering
items: Provide financial support to local community projects

ethics.title: Ethical Business Practices and Supply Chain
items: End cooperation with suppliers not adhering to fair trade principles

performance.title: Performance Measurement and Reporting
performance.description: We monitor sustainability performance through quantitative and qualitative indicators, disclose transparently, and embed results into a continuous improvement loop.
items: Publication of annual and quarterly sustainability (ESG) reports
Baseline and target year definitions to track progress

process.title: Process & Methodology
items: Data collection: operational systems, HR records, supplier disclosures
Validation: internal control + external assurance when needed
Improvement cycle: Measure - Analyze - Act - Review

assurance.title: Assurance & Improvement
items: Annual management review for critical KPI set
Risk & opportunity assessment feeding target updates
Transparency via publication of methodology notes

impact.title: Increasing Social and Environmental Impact
items: More investment in social projects and local communities
Strengthen communication efforts to increase awareness about sustainability

contact.title: Communication & Collaboration
contact.description: We collaborate with our stakeholders through transparent communication and joint sustainability projects.

conclusion.title: Conclusion & Commitment
conclusion.text: This document details TSSX Information Technologies and Consulting Inc.'s sustainability efforts and states its commitments toward a sustainable future. The policies we implement to reduce environmental impact, amplify social value, and strengthen long-term economic resilience are grounded in transparency, ethics, and continuous improvement. Together with our stakeholders, we aim for measurable, traceable, and optimizable sustainability performance.
